title: Docs Import Capability Parity Quick Reference
summary: quick status and delivery order for ordinary, returned-package, and edited-review-source Import across scopes and sub-scopes
content_html:
Docs Import Capability Parity Quick Reference

This is the short sequencing view for top-level scope and configured sub-scope Import. The linked delivery documents remain authoritative for their complete contracts and status.

Capability Scope Sub-scope Required action
Ordinary single-document/file Import Shipped Shipped in SSO-1 No parity work remains.
Returned JSON/JSONL package Import Shipped Shipped in SRR-2 No parity work remains.
Build + edited review-source-folder Import ERS-1 in progress ERS-1 in progress ERS-1.0 is complete; ERS-1.1 is the next review-gated checkpoint.

Delivery Order

SSO-1 ordinary sub-scope Import
  -> SRR-2 returned-package sub-scope Import
  -> ERS-1 shared Build + edited review-source-folder Import

Dispatch Rule

In integrated Import, registered collection recognizers receive the untouched staged candidate and front matter first. Only an unclaimed ordinary Markdown file or one-document Markdown package reaches generic front-matter stripping and create-only Import.

This prevents ordinary normalization from erasing review_* provenance before the edited-review-source recognizer can validate it.
